newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends sharply higher as Europe freezes.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends sharply higher as Europe freezes.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures ticked higher at the close, driven by strong demand for heating oil in Europe.
January gas oil finished up $8.25 a tonne at $232 and just 75 cents off its high for the session.
"It's just a fundamentals thing," said an IPE broker. "It's cold and gas oil demand is strong."
Cold weather in Europe, stretching south to the Mediterranean, is expected to continue at least until the weekend.
IPE Brent maintained its morning gains and at 1820 GMT was up 49 cents at $24.30 a barrel.
Gas oil stretched its premium over Brent to $6 for February contracts.
Dealers said relatively mild winter weather in the important U.S. northeast heating oil market had the potential to put a cap on rising European values.
"At these levels prices are looking a little toppy for me," said a trader.
